bns_sections.description: Unlawful taking of movable property with intent to dishonestly remove it from possession
precautions: Secure personal belongings and avoid displaying valuables publicly
Report the incident immediately to local authorities with all available details
Keep important documents and identification in safe storage
Be aware of surroundings and avoid isolated areas when carrying valuables

bns_sections.description: Intentional use of criminal force against another person without consent
precautions: Seek immediate medical attention if any physical injuries are sustained
Document all injuries with photographs and medical reports
Avoid further confrontation with the perpetrator for personal safety
Consider informing trusted contacts about the incident for support

bns_sections.description: Theft involving force, threat of force, or fear of immediate harm
precautions: Prioritize personal safety over property protection during incidents
Provide detailed descriptions of perpetrators to investigating officers
Review security measures for home or business premises
Consider counseling support if experiencing trauma from the incident

bns_sections.description: Unlawful entry into building with intent to commit an offense
precautions: Enhance physical security with improved locks and lighting systems
Install security cameras and alarm systems if feasible
Inform trusted neighbors about the incident for community awareness
Review and update home or property insurance coverage as needed

bns_sections.description: Intentional deception to induce another to deliver property or consent
precautions: Monitor all financial accounts closely for unauthorized transactions
Report incidents to banks and relevant financial institutions immediately
Be cautious of unsolicited communications requesting personal information
Maintain records of all relevant documents and communications

bns_sections.description: Threatening another with injury to person, reputation or property
precautions: Document all threats received with dates, times, and methods of communication
Inform local authorities immediately about any threatening behavior
Consider seeking protective measures if threats appear credible
Avoid being alone in isolated locations until situation is resolved

bns_sections.description: Causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to another person
precautions: Obtain medical evaluation and treatment for all injuries sustained
Keep detailed medical records and photographs of injuries as evidence
Report the incident to authorities with complete factual information
Consider support services if experiencing ongoing effects from the incident

bns_sections.description: Causing severe bodily injury including fractures, permanent disfigurement
precautions: Seek immediate emergency medical attention for serious injuries
Ensure comprehensive medical documentation of all injuries sustained
Contact authorities immediately to report the serious nature of the assault
Consider legal consultation regarding the severity of injuries sustained

bns_sections.description: Group robbery involving five or more persons acting together
precautions: Report group criminal activity to authorities with all available details
Provide descriptions of all perpetrators if safely possible to observe
Avoid areas known for group criminal activity until situation improves
Consider community safety measures and neighborhood watch programs

bns_sections.description: Voluntarily obstructing movement of another person from proceeding
precautions: Report any unlawful restraint or detention to authorities immediately
Seek safe locations and trusted contacts if feeling threatened
Document circumstances of restraint including time, location, and persons involved
Consider legal advice if restraint resulted in missed opportunities or losses

bns_sections.description: Unlawfully restraining person preventing movement beyond certain limits
precautions: Contact authorities immediately regarding unlawful confinement incidents
Seek medical attention if confinement caused physical or mental distress
Document all aspects of confinement including duration and conditions
Consider counseling services if experiencing lasting effects from incident

bns_sections.description: Making false documents with intent to cause damage or injury
precautions: Report suspected document forgery to authorities with original documents
Monitor personal credit and official records for unauthorized changes
Secure important documents and verify authenticity of official communications
Consider legal advice if forged documents have caused financial losses
